name: Mossgrove 0: Create Spreadsheet
description: Quote to cash (project 11): run once to create the Google Sheet the system runs on, with every tab and header row.

parameters.jsCode:
const c = $('Create Spreadsheet').first().json;
return [{ json: { spreadsheetId: c.spreadsheetId, url: c.spreadsheetUrl, next: 'Put the ID in workflows/config.json (SHEET_ID), rebuild and deploy, then run Mossgrove 8: Reset Demo.' } }];

parameters.content:
## Mossgrove 0: Create Spreadsheet
Run once when setting up for a new client. Creates the Google Sheet the whole system runs on (Settings, Price Book, Quotes, Events, Payments, Schedule, Outbox) with bold, frozen header rows. The owner can read and edit everything in the sheet; the workflows write as plain text, so nothing typed into the forms is treated as a formula.
